# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** About fifty years old  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P30](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0030), [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009), [v4 c40 P11](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** The over-harbor side of Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c6 P32](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0032), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c37 P14](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Marshall Elliott is a tall, strong man who previously had an eccentric appearance due to long hair reaching down his back and a full beard. Following a Liberal political victory, he was shaved and had his hair cut by a barber, removing his perambulating haystack look. Prior to his hair and beard being cut, he resembled an ancient Viking.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P31](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0031), [v4 c37 P10](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0010)_

## Personality

Marshall Elliott is a witty, intelligent, and well-read individual who is an engaging storyteller and fine tenor singer. He is extremely stubborn and determined, keeping a lifelong political vow for fifteen years. He possesses a bit of a temper, an inclination toward lighthearted humor, and a very strong, decisive nature.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c37 P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 c37 P16](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0016), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v4 c37 P18](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0018)_

## History

Marshall Elliott grew up on the over-harbor side of Four Winds as a staunch Liberal. During a heated political campaign fifteen years ago, he vowed publicly not to shave or cut his hair until his political party came into power. He strictly maintained this vow despite his party losing that election and remaining out of power for fifteen years. He spent time fishing with Captain Jim and visiting friends around Four Winds, where he joined Anne, Gilbert, Leslie, and Captain Jim to celebrate New Year's Eve at the lighthouse. When the Liberals finally won the general election, he immediately forced a reluctant local barber to shave his beard and trim his hair past midnight. After fulfilling his vow, he courted and married Cornelia Bryant, moving into her green house to live with her.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c16 P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009), [v4 c37 P10](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0010), [v4 c37 P14](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0014), [v4 c40 P11](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0011)_

## Background by volume

- Born a Liberal (Grit) into the Elliott family  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>
- Made a public vow during a bitter general election fifteen years prior to refrain from cutting his hair or beard until the Liberals won  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>
- Brother to Alexander Elliott  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- Known Captain Jim since he was ten years old  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
